title: Nomba Transaction
description: Schema representing a Nomba transaction record for payments, transfers, and payouts across the platform.

transactionId.description: The unique identifier for the transaction.

merchantTxRef.description: The merchant-provided transaction reference for idempotency and reconciliation.

fee.description: The fee charged for the transaction.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction.

type.description: The transaction type indicating the direction of funds.

source.description: The channel through which the transaction was initiated.

status.description: The current processing status of the transaction.

terminalId.description: The POS terminal identifier, present for terminal-based transactions.

rrn.description: The Retrieval Reference Number for POS transactions.

sessionId.description: The session identifier linking related transaction steps.

narration.description: A description or note associated with the transaction.

createdAt.description: The date and time the transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the transaction was last updated.
